contract_number.description: Page 1, section 1: Plan contract number. Preserve leading zeros. Exclude spouse and HCSA contract numbers. Return null if unreadable.

member_certificate_number.description: Page 1, section 1: Plan member certificate number. Preserve all letters and digits. Exclude the spouse certificate number. Return null if unreadable.

plan_member_name.description: Page 1, section 1: Plan member name, including any middle initial. Do not substitute the patient or spouse name. Return null if unreadable.

member_date_of_birth.description: Page 1, section 1: Plan member date of birth. Format DD/Mon/YYYY only when unambiguous. Exclude spouse date of birth and date signed. Return null if unreadable.

phone_number.description: Page 1, section 1: Daytime phone number. Preserve all digits and any extension. Return null if unreadable.

total_claim_amount.description: Page 2, section 11: Total amount of all receipts submitted. Return the numeric amount with two decimal places and no currency symbol or code. Do not calculate from unrelated numbers. Return null if unreadable.
